questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the first and last Indian Governor-General of independent India (1948-1950).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Battle of Buxar was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Buxar was fought on 22 October 1764 between the British and the combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II.
